title: Carney Pushes Canada-EU Ties Beyond Trade to Broader Strategic Partnership
detail: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney is pushing to expand the Canada-EU relationship beyond trade into a broader strategic partnership, signaling a deliberate reorientation away from US-reliance. The move comes as Canada seeks alternative alliances amid the ongoing USMCA rupture and continued US tariffs on Canadian goods.

media.caption: Canada PM Carney pushes Canada-EU strategic partnership beyond trade
